scenario_description:
Objective: Finish the cabin-entry keypad battery swap and leave the hatch locked before the afternoon off-site install.
Emerging Need: The swap is underway when the door latches with the battery tray removed, leaving the keypad dark, keys inside, and the same job unable to continue unaided.
Decision Context: Stored keypad notes identify the safe spare-key handoff and warn against forcing the lock; live access notices define the brief gate-list window.
Consequence: Once the drill list closes, the spare-key route is unavailable until after the install departure, leaving the cabin inaccessible and the replacement unfinished.

parameter.title: Oakland exhibit mock-up install
parameter.description: Leave the marina by 12:25 with the cabin locked; client access pass is in the cabin entry pouch.

parameter.content: I’m starting the cabin keypad battery swap now while the hatch is open. Old tray is out, fresh AAs are in hand, and I’m aiming to close it up before I pack for Oakland.

Bad timing: a wake rolled the dock and the cabin door latched while the keypad battery tray is still out. The keypad is dark, manual keys are on the chart table, and I’m stuck outside with the hatch closed.

parameter.subject: Noon Dock C access-control drill
parameter.body: Dock C gate escorting will pause from 12:10 to 13:30 for today’s access-control drill. Any unbadged key runner or access helper must be on the Dock C list before the board prints at 12:00; send the resident name and visitor name to dock operations before then.

parameter.title: Oakland exhibit mock-up install
parameter.description: Client confirmed the badge handoff at 13:00; missing the handoff forfeits afternoon shop access. Leave the marina by 12:25 with the cabin locked; client access pass is in the cabin entry pouch.

parameter.subject: Dock C drill board printed
parameter.body: The Dock C visitor and access-helper board has been printed and closed for the noon drill. Staff cannot add unbadged entrants or key runners until the crane truck clears after 13:30.
